name: Spying Curse
body:
Price 4,000 gp; Slot —; CL 10th; Weight —; Aura moderate divination

DESCRIPTION

As long as this object is held, worn, or carried by a living creature (including in an extradimensional space), the creator can concentrate for 1 minute in order to scry (as scrying) upon that creature. The target gains no saving throw against this scrying, and the creator can observe him for up to 10 rounds per day. These rounds need not be consecutive. Whenever the creator is scrying on the target, she also learns his direction, distance, and general condition.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 2,000 gp; Spells bestow curse, scrying, status
